agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The XFS scrub teardown functions unconditionally invoked `xfarray_destroy` and `xfblob_destroy` on pointers that could be NULL if the associated data structures were not successfully initialized, leading to potential NULL pointer dereferences.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch diff replaces unconditional destructor calls (e.g., `xfarray_destroy(ragi->iunlink_prev);`) with guarded calls using NULL checks (e.g., `if (ragi->iunlink_prev) xfarray_destroy(ragi->iunlink_prev);`) across multiple scrub repair files including `agheader_repair.c`, `attr_repair.c`, and `dir_repair.c`.
